name: ae5vg-amateur-radio
description: By Stefan Brunner, AE5VG. Operate an amateur radio station with Claude: fldigi for PSK, RTTY and the other digital modes, WSJT-X for FT8, FT4 and the weak-signal modes, and N3FJP for logging contacts and contests such as Field Day. Receive-only until you set your callsign.

callsign.title: Callsign
callsign.description: Your licensed callsign. It is the transmit gate for fldigi and WSJT-X: leave it blank to keep the station receive-only.

fldigi_host.title: fldigi host
fldigi_host.description: Host where fldigi runs. Leave as 127.0.0.1 unless fldigi is on another computer.

band_guidance.title: Band Guidance (experimental)
band_guidance.description: Suggest a mode's calling frequency and warn when a frequency is outside the digital band segment. Advisory only.

region.title: IARU Region
region.description: Your IARU region for Band Guidance: 1 (Europe, Africa), 2 (Americas), 3 (Asia-Pacific).

audio_device.title: Audio input for signal hunting
audio_device.description: Name, or part of it, of the input device fldigi listens on. Leave blank for the system default.

wsjtx_host.title: WSJT-X listen host
wsjtx_host.description: Address on which to receive WSJT-X's UDP messages. Leave as 127.0.0.1 for a local WSJT-X.

wsjtx_port.title: WSJT-X UDP port
wsjtx_port.description: WSJT-X Settings, Reporting, UDP Server port. Default 2237. Also enable 'Accept UDP requests' there.

wsjtx_multicast.title: WSJT-X multicast group (optional)
wsjtx_multicast.description: Multicast group to join so JTAlert, GridTracker and others can share WSJT-X. Leave blank for unicast.

n3fjp_host.title: N3FJP host
n3fjp_host.description: Leave as 127.0.0.1. If N3FJP runs on another computer, run mcp-host-bridge on this one.

n3fjp_port.title: N3FJP API port
n3fjp_port.description: N3FJP Settings, Application Program Interface. Default 1100. Not the multi-PC networking port.

allow_db_wipe.title: Allow whole-log wipe (danger)
allow_db_wipe.description: Leave off. When off, the server refuses raw SQL that could delete or overwrite your entire N3FJP log.
